plain_text:
HOMELESS SERVICES GAP ANALYSIS COMMITTEE 
 
  OCTOBER 29, 2026 
 
A meeting of the Homeless Services Gap Analysis Committee was held Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 1:01 
p.m. in the Aldermanic Chamber and duly noticed in two places, including the City’s website, in accordance 
with the requirements of RSA 91-A:2 II. 
 
Let’s start the meeting by taking a roll call attendance.   
 
The roll call was taken with 7 members of the Homeless Services Gap Analysis Committee present:   
 
Acting Chairman Bobbie Bagley presided. 
 
Members of the Committee present: Alderman-at-Large Alicia Gregg 
 Alderman Thomas Lopez 
 Tonia Knisley 
 LaTonya Muccioli 
 Jane Goodman 
 Megan Caron 
 Bobbie Bagley, Public Health Director 
  
Members of the Committee absent:  
 
Also in Attendance:  
 
             
 
ROLL CALL 
 
• J. Goodman & T. Lopez asked for clarification on when the clock starts; B. Bagley stated it starts 90 
days from today 
• Meeting is being recorded & transcribed 
• Brief discussion about allowing public comment 
• Brief discussion about moving the meeting to another room; decision was made to stay in the 
Aldermanic Chamber. 
• Consensus that Thursdays at 1PM works for the committee members. 
 
ELECTION OF OFFICERS 
 
o Chair: 
MOTION BY ALDERMAN GREGG, SECONDED BY ALDERMAN THOMAS LOPEZ, TO NOMINATE 
JANE GOODMAN AS CHAIR 
MOTION CARRIED 
o Vice Chair and Clerk: 
MOTION BY THOMAS LOPEZTO NOMINATE ALDERMAN GREGG AS THE COMMITTEE CLERK AND 
TONIA KNISLEY AS THE VICE-CHAIR 
MOTION CARRIED 
The meeting was then turned over to new Chair Jane Goodman
Homeless Services Gap Analysis Committee   10/29/2026                                                                                                         
Page 2 
   
• Discussion about the meeting schedule; consensus that meetings should be held weekly, but 
that the schedule can be modified going forward if needed, particularly around holidays. 
• Clarification that there can’t be an extension due to the holidays because it would take an 
amendment to the ordinance.  
• Clarification that the timeline is 90 days, not 90 business days. 
• Clarification that the agenda does not need to be posted, but a notice does.  
• Chairman Goodman expects to be out over the holidays; Tonia Knisley will need to Chair the 
meetings then. 
• Chairman Goodman asked committee members what they’re hoping to get out of the 
committee; a discussion commenced about the various goals of the committee members. 
Overall consensus that the committee wants to create a report with meaningful 
recommendations. 
• Alderman Lopez suggested creating a glossary of terms for the committee’s final report. 
• Chairman Goodman outlined tasks to be done before the next meeting: 
o Alderman Lopez and Megan Caron to determine what the city is doing funding-wise that 
touches this issue; 
o Chairman Goodman to decide structurally how the meetings should run and to make a 
decision regarding public comment; 
o Committee members to determine their holiday schedules 
o Jessica Connors, Administrator from Public Health, to reach out to Donna Graham 
regarding a cheat sheet and/or script for running future meetings 
   
ADJOURNMENT   
 
 
MOTION BY ALDERMAN LOPEZ TO ADJOURN 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
The meeting was declared adjourned at 1:57 p.m. 
 
        Alderman Alicia Gregg 
        Committee Clerk
